title: CAIP-122: Sign in With X (SIWx)
quote: Status: Review (created 2022-06-23). This work is meant to generalize and abstract the Sign in With Ethereum specification... nonce: Optional — Randomized token to prevent signature replay attacks... Wallet implementers MUST prevent phishing attacks by matching on the domain term... a namespace MUST provide: a signing algorithm, a type string, and a procedure for creating a signing input.

title: eip155 namespace — CAIP-122 profile
quote: Signature types eip191 (personal signatures) and eip1271 (contract signatures)... We use signature verification techniques from EIP-191 and EIP-1271 as specified as well as any additional steps specified in EIP-4361... EIP-4361 already exists, which was the inspiration for CAIP-122.

title: solana namespace — CAIP-122 profile
quote: Solana uses the Ed25519 signing algorithm... We propose using the signature type solana:ed25519... the abstract data model must be converted into a string representation in an unambiguous format, and then the string converted to a byte array to be signed over.

title: CAIP-74: CACAO — Chain-Agnostic Capability Object
quote: Represent a chain-agnostic Object Capability (OCAP), created using CAIP-122, as an IPLD object... not just an event receipt of an authentication, but also a composable and replay-able authorization receipt... payload includes issuer (as did:pkh).

title: CAIP-2: Blockchain ID Specification
quote: CAIP-2 defines a way to identify a blockchain (e.g. Ethereum Mainnet, Görli, Bitcoin, Cosmos Hub) in a human-readable, developer-friendly and transaction-friendly way... namespace:reference (e.g. eip155:1). Status: Final.

title: ChainAgnostic/namespaces — per-namespace CAIP profiles
quote: caip122.md profiles exist for exactly six namespaces as of 2026-07: arweave, eip155, solana, stacks, tezos, xrpl (repository tree listing).

title: Chain Agnostic Standards Alliance (CASA)
quote: a self-organized alliance of blockchain developers creating standards that support interoperability and facilitate communication between protocols, software, and companies... proposals are debated, drafted, and published as Chain Agnostic Improvement Proposals.

title: did-session — DID session key management (Ceramic js-did)
quote: Manages, creates and authorizes a DID session key for a user... Supports did:pkh for blockchain accounts with Sign-In with Ethereum and CACAO for authorization... By default sessions last one week.

title: Sign In With X (SIWX) — Reown AppKit documentation
quote: The Sign In With X feature is designed in accordance with the CAIP-122 standard... after AppKit version 1.5.0, you will be migrated into SIWX [from siweConfig]... supporting Ethereum, Solana, and Bitcoin.

title: Sign-In-With-X (SIWX) — x402 Documentation
quote: The Sign-In-With-X (SIWX) extension implements CAIP-122 for chain-agnostic wallet authentication... Built on CAIP-122, EIP-4361 (SIWE), and Sign-In-With-Solana.

title: ERC-4361: Sign-In with Ethereum
quote: nonce: REQUIRED (8+ alphanumeric); Status: Final; Wallet implementers MUST display to the user the following fields by default and prior to signing: scheme, domain, address, statement, resources.

title: Sign In With Solana (SIWS) — specification and reference implementation
quote: The technical specification for SIWS is modeled after EIP-4361 (Sign In With Ethereum) but extends beyond its capabilities. (The SIWS specification does not reference CAIP-122.)

title: Supporting multiple chains with CAIP-122 · ChainAgnostic/CAIPs #262
quote: if you would like to authenticate yourself with SIWx for multiple chains then you need to sign multiple messages... if a user wants to authenticate for chain A, B and C then it should sign a single message rather than 3 messages. (Open, no resolution)

title: Implementer Feedback: CAIP-122<>EIP-4361 mismatch · ChainAgnostic/CAIPs #264
quote: resources is optional in EIP-4361 and required in CAIP-122 (although nothing stops it from being present but empty). (2024-02 보고; 2026-07 현재 main 브랜치 필드 표에서는 resources가 선택으로 표기 — 본문 표가 이후 수정된 것으로 보임)
